name: LogForge Unicron
longDescription:
All in one UI, for Docker. Real-time logs, Interactive terminals, Custom alerts/notifications/Automations, File system access through separately enrolled agents.

Security notice: agents with writable Docker socket access have root-equivalent control of their Docker hosts. Only enroll trusted hosts and restrict administrator access. This Central appliance has no Docker socket mount. Enroll agents manually and manage appliance updates through Cosmos; in-app self-update and automatic local agent deployment are unavailable.

Agent enrollment uses logforge/unicron-agent:latest. Pull the image on the agent host before running its enrollment command. The Cosmos host is not monitored until an agent is enrolled.

Build transparency: The appliance packages Python services with PyInstaller. Source and build recipes are available in the linked source repository. This listing does not attest reproducible builds, source-to-image equivalence, or SBOM availability; verify any release provenance and SBOM with the publisher.
description: All-in-one Docker observability and operations UI.
